interfaces.description: Network interface(s) to monitor for ARP changes.

maclist_file.description: Path to file containing allowed MAC addresses (whitelist).

maclist_alert_file.description: Path to file containing denied MAC addresses (blacklist).

maclist_leases_file.description: Path to file for persistent ARP lease dump.

pid_file.description: Path to PID file for the running daemon.

log_file.description: Path to log file. If empty, logs are sent to syslog.

use_syslog.description: Whether to use syslog (true) or file-based logging (false).

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging (0–7). Default is 6 (full detail).

dump_packet.description: Whether to dump captured packets to stdout (for debugging).

daemon.description: Whether to run as a background daemon (true) or foreground (false).

run_as_user.description: System user to drop privileges to after starting.

action_cmd.description: Command to execute when an alert occurs. Supports %ip%, %mac%, %mac% vendor, %device%, %type% placeholders.

scan_interval.description: Number of seconds between ARP table scans (matches 'dump inter' in config).
